name: JoAi: Create Update

description.en: Post a deal, event, news, article, or job update for your team so it can appear in connected websites, directories, and public feeds. Supports scheduled publishing windows, links, media, custom props, and draft or published status for local business communication.
description.de: Veröffentliche ein Angebot, Event, News, Artikel oder Job für dein Team, damit er auf verbundenen Websites, in Verzeichnissen und öffentlichen Feeds erscheinen kann. Unterstützt geplante Zeiträume, Links sowie Entwurf- oder Veröffentlichungsstatus für lokale Betriebsinfos.

bot: Use this to create a deal, event, news, article, or job update for customers. Set startsAt/endsAt for time-limited offers, events, or job application windows. For jobs, put structured details in props: jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType (onsite|hybrid|remote), jobEmploymentType (full-time|part-time|contract|internship|temporary|volunteer|other, comma-separated), jobSalaryMin, jobSalaryMax, jobSalaryUnit (hour|day|week|month|year), jobSalaryCurrency, jobStartDate, jobApplyEmail.

description.en: When the update becomes active (ISO 8601 with Z or offset, e.g. 2026-10-09T14:00:00+02:00, optional)
description.de: Wann das Update aktiv wird (ISO 8601 mit Z oder Offset, z. B. 2026-10-09T14:00:00+02:00, optional)

description.en: When the update expires (ISO 8601 with Z or offset, e.g. 2026-10-09T16:00:00+02:00, optional)
description.de: Wann das Update abläuft (ISO 8601 mit Z oder Offset, z. B. 2026-10-09T16:00:00+02:00, optional)

description.en: URL to link from the update
description.de: URL, auf die das Update verlinkt

description.en: Media IDs to attach (JSON array of team media IDs), e.g. ["abc123"]

inputs.name: Props

description.en: Custom key/value properties as a JSON object (e.g. {"top-news":"true"}). Keys camelCase or kebab-case; values strings. Jobs use jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType, jobEmploymentType, salary fields, jobStartDate, and jobApplyEmail.
description.de: Benutzerdefinierte Eigenschaften als JSON-Objekt (z. B. {"top-news":"true"}). Schlüssel in camelCase oder Kebab-Case; Werte als Strings. Jobs nutzen jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType, jobEmploymentType, Gehaltsfelder, jobStartDate und jobApplyEmail.

inputs.bot: Optional props object (string values). For city-directory top news set {"top-news":"true"} on type=news. For jobs set jobLocation, jobWorkplaceType, jobEmploymentType, jobSalaryMin/Max/Unit/Currency, jobStartDate, and jobApplyEmail as needed.

description.en: Event kind: session (single date) or run (multi-day window)

description.de: Der Termin dauert den ganzen Tag

description.en: Internal event: visible on the business page, hidden from the city calendar
description.de: Interner Termin: auf der Betriebsseite sichtbar, im Stadtkalender ausgeblendet

description.en: Series hashid when adding an explicit occurrence
description.de: Serien-Hashid beim Anlegen eines expliziten Termins

description.en: Nominal local start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) of the occurrence; derived from startsAt when omitted
description.de: Nominaler lokaler Start (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm) des Termins; wird sonst aus startsAt abgeleitet

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
